'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jeremy G DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy G]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' Jedi Jer
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
